name: Performance Monitor 🚀👻
description: Monitor performance when core components are modified

actions.prompt:
A performance-critical file has been modified. Please:
1. Check for potential performance bottlenecks
2. Verify proper memoization usage (React.memo, useMemo, useCallback)
3. Look for unnecessary re-renders
4. Check bundle size impact
5. Suggest optimizations for large datasets
6. Ensure animations are 60fps smooth

Keep our haunted mansion running at supernatural speeds! ⚡🏚️
